ddl.value: ("team_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("athlete_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: assignment_targets_exactly_one_target

ddl.value:
(
        ("target_type" = 'team' AND "team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "athlete_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("target_type" = 'athlete' AND "athlete_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "team_id" IS NULL)
      )
ddl.name: assignment_targets_target_shape

ddl.value: ("source_plan_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("source_workout_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: assignments_exactly_one_source

ddl.value:
("source_plan_id" IS NULL) OR (
        "start_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "end_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "scheduled_date" IS NULL
      )
ddl.name: assignments_plan_source_dates

ddl.value:
("source_workout_id" IS NULL) OR (
        "scheduled_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "start_date" IS NULL
        AND "end_date" IS NULL
      )
ddl.name: assignments_workout_source_dates

ddl.value: "start_date" IS NULL OR "end_date" IS NULL OR "start_date" <= "end_date"
ddl.name: assignments_plan_date_order

ddl.value: "available_from" IS NULL OR "available_until" IS NULL OR "available_from" < "available_until"
ddl.name: assignments_availability_order
